content: Breakout strategy winner vs loser discriminators: (1) Volume ratio — RVOL > 2.0 is baseline for valid breakouts; RVOL > 3.0 strong; without 2x volume surge most breakouts fail within 1-2 bars — the single strongest discriminator; (2) ADX surge — ADX rising from below 20 to above 25 within a few bars signals high-probability breakout; DI+ must align bullish; (3) BB squeeze duration — longer prior squeeze = more explosive breakout; width at 40th percentile vs historical; (4) Distance from 52-week high — closer = less overhead resistance = better follow-through; breakouts from within 3% of 52w high have best outcomes; (5) RSI at breakout bar — 60-70 range is optimal; above 70 = overbought entry; below 55 = momentum lacking; (6) Prior base tightness — tighter 20-day consolidation range = better breakout. Overall win rate for breakouts is 40-50% with high RR. Volume ratio is the most documented discriminator across all quantitative studies.
